question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The door was ajar and Jenny __observed__ in.
solution:
The correct answer is: peeped

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The context of the sentence is that Jenny **glanced in** through the open door..
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• Observ
